theory.heading: What MCP Resource and Tool Discovery is
theory.body: MCP Resource and Tool Discovery describes the methods and patterns used within Agentic AI to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: MCP Resource and Tool Discovery is a named, repeatable concept.

theory.heading: Why MCP Resource and Tool Discovery matters
theory.body: Without MCP Resource and Tool Discovery, systems built with Agentic AI are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How MCP Resource and Tool Discovery works
theory.body: The mechanism behind MCP Resource and Tool Discovery follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of MCP Resource and Tool Discovery.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of MCP Resource and Tool Discovery
theory.body: MCP Resource and Tool Discovery offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
